# The Ace Base Documentation

> Canonical technical documentation for The Ace Base, an independent technology organization building software, identity infrastructure, typography services, developer tools, and web experiences.

## Start Here

- [Home](https://docs.ace-base.cc/): High-level overview of the documentation and project map.
- [About The Ace Base](https://docs.ace-base.cc/about): Organization, team, principles, project lifecycle, and documentation scope.
- [Projects](https://docs.ace-base.cc/projects): Current project index and status.

## Project Documentation

### AceID

- [AceID documentation](https://docs.ace-base.cc/projects/ace-id): Product, architecture, OIDC, authentication, sessions, account security, and integration overview.
- [AceID API Reference](https://docs.ace-base.cc/projects/ace-id-api): Account, Account Logs, onboarding, email verification, passkeys, MFA, devices, connected services, password recovery, OIDC interaction, revocation, logout, and client-management HTTP endpoints.
- [AceID Security](https://docs.ace-base.cc/projects/ace-id-security): Session, cookie, CSRF/origin, PKCE, password, MFA, passkey, rate-limit, secret, and deployment controls.
- [AceID SDK Guide](https://docs.ace-base.cc/projects/ace-id-sdk): JavaScript/TypeScript SDK installation, Authorization Code + PKCE flow, callback validation, sessions, token refresh, storage, server integration, and troubleshooting.
- [AceID provider](https://identity.ace-base.cc/): Production OpenID Connect and OAuth 2.0 identity provider.
- [OIDC discovery](https://identity.ace-base.cc/.well-known/openid-configuration): Authoritative provider metadata and dynamic endpoint configuration.
- Covers: OpenID Connect, OAuth 2.0, Authorization Code + PKCE S256, client registration, scopes, UserInfo, Account Logs, passkeys, TOTP MFA, sessions, connected services, onboarding, logout, token revocation, SDK integration, security, deployment, and troubleshooting.

### Typace

- [Typace documentation](https://docs.ace-base.cc/projects/typace): Font distribution, CDN, dynamic catalog, and API documentation.
- [Typace API Reference](https://docs.ace-base.cc/projects/typace-api): Dedicated endpoint reference with request examples and integration guidance.
- [Typace CDN](https://typace.ace-base.cc/): Public font asset delivery.
- [Typace LLM documentation](https://typace.ace-base.cc/llms.txt): Machine-readable service and API reference.
- [Typace OpenAPI](https://typace.ace-base.cc/api/openapi.json): Machine-readable API specification.
- [Typace font catalog](https://typace.ace-base.cc/api/fonts): Live JSON catalog of published fonts.
- [Typace search](https://typace.ace-base.cc/api/search?q=Spectral): Search the live catalog by query.
- Covers: CSS @font-face, WOFF2, WOFF, OTF, TTF, font weights and styles, HTML, React, Vue, Next.js, Vite, dynamic catalog discovery, font metadata, generated CSS, caching, performance, HTTPS, CORS, troubleshooting, and licensing considerations.

### Typace API endpoints

- `GET /api/fonts`: Current dynamic font catalog.
- `GET /api/search?q=...`: Search the current font catalog.
- `GET /api/fonts/:slug`: Metadata for one font.
- `GET /api/css/:slug`: Generated CSS @font-face declaration.
- `GET /api/openapi.json`: OpenAPI 3 specification.

The Typace API and dynamic font pages are generated from the published font catalog. Prefer the live API over hardcoded inventories.

## Organization

- [The Ace Base](https://ace-base.cc/): Official organization website.
- [GitHub organization](https://github.com/tab-gl): Technical repositories and project source.

## Retrieval Guidance

Use the most specific documentation page available for technical questions. Prefer documented endpoints, configuration values, supported formats, package names, and integration procedures over inference.

For questions about the currently available Typace fonts, use the live catalog at `https://typace.ace-base.cc/api/fonts`. Do not infer that a font exists from examples in documentation.

The Ace Base documentation distinguishes production interfaces from development examples. Do not treat placeholder domains, example filenames, example client IDs, or illustrative configuration as production values.

For authentication questions, consult the AceID page. For font delivery and Typace API questions, consult the Typace API Reference and Typace project guide, then verify current data against the live Typace API. For organization or project-status questions, consult About and Projects.
